items: (b) Push the yoke into the transmission.

content.description: Illustration showing hands pushing yoke into transmission

content.text: 2. CONNECT PROPELLER SHAFT FLANGE TO COMPANION FLANGE ON DIFFERENTIAL

items: (a) Align the marks on the flanges and connect the flanges with four bolts and nuts.

content.component: Propeller shaft flange to companion flange bolts

content.description: Illustration showing alignment marks on flanges being connected with bolts

content.text: 3. CONNECT CENTER SUPPORT BEARING TO BODY

items: (a) Place a height spacer between the body and center support bearing, and install the two mounting bolts finger tight.

content.text: NOTE: Some vehicles do not have a spacer. In this case, it is not necessary to insert one.

content.description: Illustration showing center support bearing with shims on both sides

items: (b) Check that the bearing bracket is at right angle to the propeller shaft. Adjust the bracket if necessary.
(c) Check that the center line of the center bearing is set to the center line of the bracket when the vehicle is in a no-load condition. Adjust the bracket if necessary.
